milestones.title: v0.4 — Proven on live data
milestones.description: Everything so far is tested against mocked APIs. Run it for real, fix what breaks, and put CI in place so it stays working.

issues.title: First live run against Crossref, OpenAlex, arXiv, PubMed and Ollama
issues.body:
Run `rra verify examples/sample_manuscript.md` with a real Ollama model.

**Done when**
- All six sample references get the expected verdicts
- Any parsing or response-shape differences from the mocks are fixed and covered by a test
- Wall-clock time for the sample is recorded in the README

issues.title: Test on three real manuscripts in different citation formats
issues.body:
Use open-access papers with numeric citations (e.g. one biomedical, one CS preprint, one environmental science).

**Done when**
- Reference parsing recall is measured (references found ÷ references in the paper)
- False 'metadata_mismatch' cases are logged as issues

issues.title: GitHub Actions: pytest and frontend build on every push
issues.body:
**Done when**
- Workflow runs `pytest -q` on Python 3.10–3.13 and `npm ci && npm run build`
- Status badge in README

issues.title: Check install and run on Windows
issues.body:
Paths, venv activation and `rra serve` on Windows 11.

**Done when** README install steps work verbatim on Windows.

issues.title: Record live API responses as test fixtures (metadata only)
issues.body:
Replace hand-written response shapes with recorded ones, keeping abstracts synthetic so no publisher text is committed.

**Done when** fixtures are regenerated by a script and tests pass against them.

milestones.title: v0.5 — Full-text evidence
milestones.description: Judging claims against abstracts alone misses most of what papers say. Retrieve open-access full text and check claims against the right passage.

issues.title: Fetch open-access full text (OpenAlex OA locations, Unpaywall, Europe PMC, arXiv PDF)
issues.body:
Respect each source's terms and rate limits; cache and log every download.

**Done when** the share of sources with full text is reported per run.

issues.title: Passage retrieval: find the most relevant chunks for each claim
issues.body:
Chunk full text, embed locally (Ollama embeddings), retrieve top-k passages for the support check.

**Done when** the evidence quote is checked against the retrieved passage and its page/section is shown.

issues.title: Show evidence scope (abstract vs full text) in report and UI
issues.body: **Done when** every verdict says what text it was judged against.

issues.title: New LangGraph node: retrieve_evidence between verify_references and check_support
issues.body:
Keeps retrieval separately checkpointed and auditable.

**Done when** a run can resume after a crash during retrieval.

milestones.title: v0.6 — Real-world manuscripts
milestones.description: Accept the formats researchers actually use.

issues.title: Author–year citations, e.g. (Smith et al., 2020)
issues.body: **Done when** claims are linked to references in author–year manuscripts, with ambiguous matches flagged rather than guessed.

issues.title: Upload .docx and PDF manuscripts
issues.body: **Done when** text, citations and the reference list are extracted from both, and extraction problems are shown to the user.

issues.title: Accept BibTeX/RIS reference files
issues.body:
Structured references remove most parsing errors.

**Done when** a .bib uploaded with the manuscript replaces heuristic reference parsing.

milestones.title: v0.7 — Measured performance
milestones.description: Replace the pitch's targets (zero hallucinated citations, 50–70% time saved) with numbers measured on labelled data and a pilot.

issues.title: Benchmark claim-support verdicts on a labelled claim–evidence dataset
issues.body:
Candidate: SciFact (claims labelled SUPPORTS / REFUTES against abstracts). Map to our verdicts.

**Done when** precision and recall per verdict are reported, especially how often 'supported' is wrong.

issues.title: Fabricated-citation detection test set
issues.body:
Mix real references with plausible fakes and real DOIs attached to the wrong paper.

**Done when** detection rate for each failure type is reported.

issues.title: Compare local models on the benchmark
issues.body:
At least three Ollama models, logged by digest.

**Done when** accuracy, needs-review rate and run time per model are in a table in the README.

issues.title: Time-on-task pilot with researchers
issues.body:
Same manuscripts checked by hand vs with the tool.

**Done when** time saved and errors caught are reported with the sample size.

milestones.title: v0.8 — Integrity and bias checks
milestones.description: Concrete, named checks rather than a general 'bias mitigator'. Each one reports evidence a reviewer can verify.

issues.title: Retraction and correction notices from Crossref/Retraction Watch data
issues.body:
Include expressions of concern and corrections, not just retractions.

**Done when** each notice links to its source.

issues.title: Reference-list profile: publication years, journals, self-citation
issues.body: **Done when** the report shows the distribution and flags heavy concentration (thresholds configurable, defaults documented).

issues.title: Screen journals against a predatory/hijacked journal list
issues.body: **Done when** matches are flagged with the list's name and date; no flag is shown as definitive.

issues.title: Detect personal data in uploaded manuscripts
issues.body:
Emails, phone numbers, participant identifiers.

**Done when** detected items are flagged before any external lookup is made.

milestones.title: v1.0 — Multi-user deployment
milestones.description: Make it safe for a team or journal to use.

issues.title: Authentication and roles (author, reviewer, admin)
issues.body: **Done when** every endpoint requires a signed-in user and actions are checked against their role.

issues.title: Reviewer independence: the uploader cannot sign off their own run
issues.body: **Done when** the API refuses self-sign-off and the audit log records the reviewer's identity from the session, not a typed name.

issues.title: Move checkpoints and run data to Postgres
issues.body: **Done when** several workers can run checks at once without SQLite locking.

issues.title: Docker Compose: API, frontend and Ollama
issues.body: **Done when** `docker compose up` gives a working system.

issues.title: Export an audit bundle and publish its hash
issues.body:
Zip of manuscript, report, audit log and response cache.

**Done when** anyone can re-verify a run offline from the bundle.
